title: Group OSCORE: membership rekey on removal + new member
description: Child of project-LICHEN-worker6-9mkj. Owner/admin rekey flow: on member removal generate new master_secret, increment key_epoch, distribute to remaining members via pairwise wrap; removed member must not receive new key nor decrypt new traffic; new member receives current key only (no historical access). Drives vectors rekey_distribution_to_all, member_removal_no_rekey_access, new_member_no_old_key.
